definitions.explanation: Interrogative form of the counter {位|い} (place/rank). Used to ask about finishing position or ranking in competitions, charts, surveys, and so on.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{世界|せかい}ランキングで{何位|なんい}ですか?
{今回|こんかい}の{大会|たいかい}で{彼女|かのじょ}が{何位|なんい}に{入|はい}るか、{誰|だれ}にも{予想|よそう}できなかった。
examples.english: No one could predict what place she would finish in this tournament.

notes:
Compound of {何|なん} (what) + the counter {位|い} (place/rank). Standard interrogative for asking about ranking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何位|なんい}になる: to come in what place
- {何位|なんい}に{入|はい}る: to finish in what position
- ランキング{何位|なんい}: what rank in the ranking

RELATED WORDS:
- {一位|いちい}: first place
- {二位|にい}: second place
- {上位|じょうい}: high rank; top positions
- {順位|じゅんい}: ranking; order of placement
